zh: 固定包数 k 之后，每种卡片都要补到 k 的倍数，各种卡片互不影响；某种卡片要补多少张只和它的数量除以 k 的余数有关。
枚举包数 k，对每种数量 c 计算补齐量 (k − c mod k) mod k 并求和，在所有 k 中取最小值。k 只需枚举到最大数量 M 再加 1：再大的 k 会让每种卡片都补得更多。
先把数量相同的种类合并计数；对 k = 2..M+1 逐个计算“频次 × 补齐量”的总和，维护最小值后输出。注意 cardTypes=[1] 时最优包数是 2，需要补 1 张。
en: Once the number of packs k is fixed, every card type must be padded up to a multiple of k, and types do not affect each other; how many cards a type needs depends only on its count modulo k.

Enumerate the pack count k, compute the padding (k − c mod k) mod k for each count c, sum it, and take the minimum over all k. It is enough to try k up to the largest count M plus 1: any larger k makes every type need more cards.

Group types with equal counts first; for k = 2..M+1 compute the sum of frequency times padding, keep the minimum, and print it. Note that for cardTypes=[1] the best pack count is 2, which needs 1 extra card.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Enumerate the number of packs k≥2. For each type with count c, padding it to a multiple of k takes (k−c mod k) mod k cards; add up the cards needed over all types and take the minimum. It suffices to enumerate up to M+1, where M=max(cardTypes): when k>M each type needs k−c cards, and the total strictly increases with k, so a larger k can never be better.

## Proof of correctness

For any fixed pack count k, to split one card type evenly into k packs, the number of added cards must be the smallest non-negative x such that c+x is divisible by k, namely (k−c mod k) mod k. Types are independent, so the sum is the minimum number of additions for that k. Every k that could improve the optimum lies in 2..M+1: M+1 already pads every type up to M+1, and for any larger k the amount added to each type strictly increases. Iterating over these k and taking the minimum gives the global optimum.

## Complexity

O(n+M²) time and O(M) space; on this site M=max(cardTypes)≤1000.
